u0: Initial stage: the blocking ball has not yet been cleared from the doorway while you are not carrying the matching door key. Move the ball off the cell directly in front of the locked door; if you are already carrying the matching key, put it down first or otherwise avoid holding it when the ball becomes clear. The first reward-machine transition occurs when blocker_moved is true and has_door_key is false. Until then, the door remains closed and the target box is unreachable.
u1: Doorway-cleared, key-missing stage: the ball is no longer on the cell in front of the door, but you are not carrying the matching door key. If the ball is still in hand, drop it somewhere away from the doorway so your hands are free. Your next objective is to pick up the matching key while keeping the doorway clear; reaching blocker_moved and has_door_key advances you to the key-in-hand, pre-unlock stage. The door is still closed.
u2: Key-in-hand, pre-unlock stage: the doorway is clear and you are carrying the matching door key, but the door has not been opened. Go to the door, face it, and toggle it open with the key. Do not drop the key while the door is closed, or the key will be lost at that step and you will need to retrieve it again. The next transition occurs when door_open and has_door_key both hold; then enter the box room.
u3: Door-open stage: the door to the target room is open, the key/door subtask has been completed, and the mission-named box has not yet been picked up. Enter the box room and, because you can carry only one object, drop the key if it is still in hand so you can pick up the designated box. Dropping the key while the door is open does not count as key_lost. The final transition occurs when target_picked_up becomes true.
u4: Terminal success: the mission's designated target box is in your possession and the episode has ended. The earlier doorway-clearing and key/locked-door subtasks have been credited, and no further objective remains.
